therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: protein degradation pathway disruption leading to myeloma cell apoptosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed or not controllable multiple myeloma

safety_signals: infections more common in Vd arm
results.dose_information: Bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 IV days 1,4,8,11 every 21 days for 8 cycles; Dexamethasone 20 mg oral days 1+2,4+5,8+9,11+12; Cyclophosphamide 50 mg oral daily continuously

context.duration: 8 cycles of 21 days each with up to 72 weeks follow-up
